messages:
clara-h: Heads up 60-secondment question. I'm going to the UK on a 6-month secondment starting 2026-09-01. HR recorded business travel on 2026-08-15 but payroll still shows US-only withholding. Need clarity on UK tax registration, payroll withholding, and how this shows on my US W-2 at year end.

jen-people-ops: @clara-h thanks for flagging. @samir-payroll and @tax-counsel can you advise next steps? Also confirm if Redwood will do payroll in the UK or keep you on US payroll (and whether there's any gross-up).

payroll-bot: Created ticket PR-2026-472: "UK secondment tax/withholding coordination - Clara H (emp 51702)" assigned to samir-payroll.

samir-payroll: Quick checklist: 1) confirm assignment type (employer of record change vs US payroll with remote work), 2) provide passport/visa dates and UK start date, 3) confirm if company will register PAYE or if you're remaining on US payroll and filing UK self-assessment. Without UK payroll, company may need to file a payroll registration if local law requires.

clara-h: Assignment type: Redwood will keep me on US payroll for the first 3 months, then decide. No gross-up agreed yet. Passport/visa attached to the ticket (start 2026-09-01).

tax-counsel: Two high-level tax points: (a) UK stat residency is based on the Statutory Residence Test; 6 months puts you close to UK tax residence — we'll calculate days. (b) If you become UK resident and not paid through PAYE, you may owe UK tax on employment income; double taxation relief depends on US-UK treaty and whether taxes are withheld. We'll review treaty tie-breakers and whether a UK payroll registration is needed.

samir-payroll: For US reporting: even if you pay UK tax, your US W-2 will still show total wages paid by Redwood. We can provide a breakdown or letter for your CPA. If taxes are withheld in the UK, you may claim foreign tax credit on US return. If we set up UK payroll later in the year, we may need to issue a W-2 with UK wage split notes or potentially a W-2c if year-end reporting changes.

hr-biz-partner: Manager confirmed assignment. We need payroll to estimate withholding scenarios so we can decide whether to move to UK payroll or keep on US payroll. Cost/benefit and compliance will inform the choice.

samir-payroll: Action plan: 1) I'll run a provisional ledger showing projected US withholding if stay on US payroll for 3 months and partial UK withholding if PAYE starts midyear, 2) tax-counsel will run residency calc and treaty impact, 3) we'll post scenario numbers to PR-2026-472 in 7 business days. If UK payroll is established, we'll coordinate final forms and year-end reporting guidance (W-2 + UK P60 equivalent).

clara-h: Thanks 50. Please cc my external tax advisor on the ticket once you have numbers.

jen-people-ops: Noted. Closing the Slack thread for now; will update here with final resolution. :white_check_mark:
